shortDescription: Manage QoS meter groups on F5OS

options.name: interfaces
options.description: Specifies the interfaces to associate with the meter group.

options.name: meters
options.description: Specifies the list of traffic priorities and weights that together make a meter.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the meter group.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), this option creates qkview file on specified remote host. If C(absent), this option deletes qkview file on the device (if it exists). When deleting a traffic priority make sure it is not the default for any QoS.
